Profile Aclatonium napadisilate is a cholinergic agonist given orally for its prokinetic properties in the management of decreased gas- trointestinal motility (p.1694) after gastrointestinal surgery, and to relieve symptoms of biliary dyskinesia and chronic gastritis. Pharmacopoeias. In Jpn. Profile Albumin tannate, a compound of tannin with albumin, is given orally for its astringent properties in the treatment of diarrhoea (p.1694).
